refreshNotes: All-new model. The Optiq debuted for the 2025 model year as Cadillac's entry-level EV. Available in four trims: Luxury 1, Luxury 2, Sport 1, Sport 2 — all dual-motor AWD with an 85-kWh battery, 300 hp / 354 lb-ft, 302 mile range. Pricing from $52,895 (Luxury 1) to mid-$57Ks (Sport 2). Sources: [Edmunds 2025 Optiq](https://www.edmunds.com/cadillac/optiq/2025/), [CarGurus 2025 Optiq pricing](https://www.cargurus.com/research/articles/2025-cadillac-optiq-pricing-specs-release-date).
